[aida:product] #2033's hold condition is MET. STORY-1422 is Completed, so the sequence you set is ready for its next step — and I am out of assigned work.

    STORY-1422   Completed   (#2049 merged)
    #2033        OPEN, mergeable=MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED
                 Build (ubuntu-latest) PASS
                 merge-hold-gate FAIL  <- the only thing blocking it
                 marker .aida/merge-holds/PR-2033 present, label aida:merge-hold present

Your ruling was "#2033's hold comes off only after STORY-1422 lands". It has landed. Clearing the hold is yours, not mine, and I am not touching it — flagging it because the board has been waiting on exactly this and nothing else stands in front of it.

THE SEQUENCE YOU DEFINED, for reference: #2049 lands the mechanism (done) → #2033 lands the fix → then this repo registers and enables both jobs and we watch the guard go quiet. That folds the enablement, criterion 2's zero half and criterion 7's re-measurement into one act.

I HAVE THE PRE-FIX HALF HELD AND UNRECORDED as you instructed: 20.2% of 5656 calls over a 1000ms budget, exit 1, measured against the unfixed binary. You said not to record it formally until the pair is captured across the same enablement act. It is ready whenever you call for it.

AND THE REVIEWER'S ADDITION APPLIES HERE — capture the proportion BEFORE enabling, not only after, because once #2033 lands a silent gate and a gate that never executed are indistinguishable from outside. The pre-fix number above is that first half.

MY QUEUE IS EMPTY. All three assigned are done: #2049 merged, #1974 merged, #1981 open at 4a3c433d6a and MERGEABLE with the reviewer. Nothing of mine is blocked on me.

WHAT I CAN TAKE, in the order I would pick if it is my call:
  1. the enablement act itself, once #2033 lands — it is STORY-1422's remaining criteria and I have the context
  2. BUG-1557 (parity test: scaffolded schedule commands vs the allowlist) — queued unassigned, and it is the general form of the gap I hit
  3. BUG-1554 (doctor category registered in three places, drift already present in two names)
  4. #2001 / #2030 / #2040 — still held as briefed to codex, still zero head movement; yours to reassign, not mine to take

Say which and I start. If the answer is "wait for #2033", say that too and I will pick up 2 or 3 in the meantime rather than idle.
subject: #2033's hold condition is MET (STORY-1422 Completed) — only merge-hold-gate blocks it; my queue is empty, four candidates listed
